name: Phone PWA clipped-button self-heal rehearsal
target: Rehearse a Fold-sized PWA CTA clipping diagnosis, responsive CSS repair, and re-observation without a browser, adb device, or external network
inputs: intentionally broken PWA fixture with min-width: 476px
observations: before-repair CTA right edge is 460px, outside the 360px viewport
responsive repair removes the minimum width and wraps the action row
after-repair CTA right edge is 344px and the verdict is visible
the graph trace orders phone-observe, viewport-judge, responsive-repair, and phone-reobserve
without the repair node the scenario remains blocked and does not report green
the fallback trace labels itself simulator-only and makes no live-device claim
